aboutGame.title: What is Bless You Again?
paragraphs: Bless You Again is a fantasy action roguelike in which every expedition sends you through procedurally arranged chambers packed with hostile guardians and rare divine favors. You fight in real time using directional dodges, parries, and posture-breaking heavy strikes, then spend the essence you collect on permanent upgrades that carry into your next attempt.

Each run is defined by its blessing system. Altars and defeated champions offer boons across schools such as Radiant Sol, Aegis Ward, Gale Swiftness, Umbral Decay, and Feral Instinct, and combining those blessings with your chosen archetype and companions like Lily is the key to surviving deeper floors. This wiki gathers the guides, builds, and reference data you need in one place.

modules.description: This module introduces new players to the core gameplay loop, including dungeon exploration, combat basics, character growth, and early progression tips. It helps beginners understand how to start their adventure with Lily and make efficient decisions.

highlights.detail: Clear early chambers and study enemy telegraphs before pushing into deeper floors
Bank Sanctified Ash into health and healing nodes so your runs last longer
Choose a starting archetype that matches the range and mobility you enjoy
Commit to two blessing schools instead of collecting rare but unsynergistic boons
Save at least one dash charge for emergencies and keep defensive consumables ready
Unlock the Second Breath revive talent before attempting the second biome boss

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Bless You Again.

items.question: What is Bless You Again?
items.answer: Bless You Again is a fantasy action roguelike in which each expedition sends you through procedurally arranged chambers full of guardians and divine favors. You fight in real time with dodges, parries, and posture-breaking strikes, then spend collected essence on permanent upgrades for future runs.

items.question: Do I need to finish a run to make progress in Bless You Again?
items.answer: No. Bless You Again is built around rogue-lite meta-progression, so even a failed expedition feeds essence and Starlight Runes into permanent upgrades that make your next attempt stronger.

items.question: Which starter archetype is best for beginners in Bless You Again?
items.answer: The Vanguard Knight and Grove Warden are the most forgiving starting archetypes thanks to their higher health pools and dependable mobility, while the Arcane Seeker and Shadow Striker reward more experienced players.

items.question: How do blessings work in Bless You Again?
items.answer: Clearing chambers and defeating champions in Bless You Again lets you choose blessings from schools such as Radiant Sol, Aegis Ward, Gale Swiftness, Umbral Decay, and Feral Instinct. Pairing two synergistic schools beats hoarding the rarest individual boons.

items.question: Is Bless You Again available on consoles?
items.answer: Bless You Again launches on PC through Steam first, with console versions for platforms such as PlayStation and Switch evaluated based on reception and technical feasibility.
